import ctypes
import numpy as np

def compute_statistics(data):
    # Load the required libraries
    ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

    # Define the argument and return types for the GSL functions
    gsl.gsl_sort.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl.gsl_stats_median_from_sorted_data.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl.gsl_stats_median_from_sorted_data.restype = ctypes.c_double
    gsl.gsl_stats_quantile_from_sorted_data.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_double]
    gsl.gsl_stats_quantile_from_sorted_data.restype = ctypes.c_double

    # Convert the input data to a ctypes array
    n = len(data)
    data_array = (ctypes.c_double * n)(*data)

    # Sort the data
    gsl.gsl_sort(data_array, 1, n)

    # Compute the statistics
    median = gsl.gsl_stats_median_from_sorted_data(data_array, 1, n)
    upperq = gsl.gsl_stats_quantile_from_sorted_data(data_array, 1, n, 0.75)
    lowerq = gsl.gsl_stats_quantile_from_sorted_data(data_array, 1, n, 0.25)

    return median, upperq, lowerq

def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: Example dataset
    data = [17.2, 18.1, 16.5, 18.3, 12.6]
    median, upperq, lowerq = compute_statistics(data)
    assert np.isclose(median, 17.2, atol=1e-6), f"Expected median 17.2, got {median}"
    assert np.isclose(upperq, 18.1, atol=1e-6), f"Expected upper quartile 18.1, got {upperq}"
    assert np.isclose(lowerq, 16.5, atol=1e-6), f"Expected lower quartile 16.5, got {lowerq}"

    # Test case 2: Single element dataset
    data = [42.0]
    median, upperq, lowerq = compute_statistics(data)
    assert np.isclose(median, 42.0, atol=1e-6), f"Expected median 42.0, got {median}"
    assert np.isclose(upperq, 42.0, atol=1e-6), f"Expected upper quartile 42.0, got {upperq}"
    assert np.isclose(lowerq, 42.0, atol=1e-6), f"Expected lower quartile 42.0, got {lowerq}"

    # Test case 3: Dataset with repeated values
    data = [5.0, 5.0, 5.0, 5.0, 5.0]
    median, upperq, lowerq = compute_statistics(data)
    assert np.isclose(median, 5.0, atol=1e-6), f"Expected median 5.0, got {median}"
    assert np.isclose(upperq, 5.0, atol=1e-6), f"Expected upper quartile 5.0, got {upperq}"
    assert np.isclose(lowerq, 5.0, atol=1e-6), f"Expected lower quartile 5.0, got {lowerq}"

    print("All tests passed.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
